info.description: One numbered section of the Mandatory Public Disclosure page. ⚠⚠ `anchor` IS A URL TARGET. It is the id the section carries and the href the side rail links to, so changing it breaks any link a parent or an inspector has saved to that section. Change the label freely; change the anchor only deliberately. ⚠ THE LABEL USED TO BE WRITTEN TWICE — once for the rail, once as the section heading — and the two could drift. One record now feeds both. The section number is derived from position, not stored.
